dialogues.speaker: Material-Collecting Aranara
dialogues.text: Golden Nara, can you give Aranara <color=#00E1FFFF>a Viparyas</color>, and <color=#00E1FFFF>a Sumeru Rose</color> too?

dialogues.speaker: Material-Collecting Aranara
dialogues.text: Want <color=#00E1FFFF>a Viparyas and a Sumeru Rose</color>. Please, Nara friend.

dialogues.speaker: Material-Collecting Aranara
dialogues.text: Hehe, Golden Nara picked these. Thank you!

dialogues.speaker: Material-Collecting Aranara
dialogues.text: Good Nara, you're welcome in Vanarana. Aranara will wait for you there!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, it's the creature we saw before! What's going on here?
